experience_choices.en: I train regularly and know the basic movements
experience_choices.es: Entreno con regularidad y conozco los movimientos básicos

uncertainty.behavior: Offer beginner as a starting point and require explicit confirmation; do not infer an experience level.

teen_policy_note: Draft product scope aligns with existing generator foundation mapping; no weight-loss goals or automatic Hard eligibility. Existing supervision and reviewed regional access requirements remain active.
constraints: Goal and experience are required explicit choices; no inference from physique, optional measurements or avatar.
No weight-loss, calorie, fasting or appearance goals.
No new plan is generated until equipment, schedule and other required training inputs exist and production content gates permit it.
Goal and experience changes do not delete prior progress or confer rewards.
An existing readiness pause is preserved; this window cannot clear it.
Return and language changes preserve the draft; exit discards unsaved changes.

navigation.depends_on: WIN-009 and upstream authenticated eligibility/consent gates

persistence: Proposal only. Future private profile fields; no backend or runtime implementation is added here.
reference_status: Retained ES/EN v1 full-screen principal adult goal-step proposals generated with built-in ImageGen and visually inspected; target approval pending.
